checks.description: USDC allocated by Gami Labs across Stellar lending and liquidity strategies. Deposits mint earnUSDC shares that track the value of the vault’s assets.
A tokenized vault allocates deposits across its configured Soroban yield strategies. Each vault fixes its allowed strategies at creation and charges fees on gains.
Supply USDC to a Blend lending pool and earn interest paid by borrowers. Rates move with utilization; the position accrues through non-transferable supply accounting.
Stellar deposits enter curated vaults that lend into selected markets and issue transferable shares. Exits use idle assets or a withdrawal queue while allocators recall funds.
A Sentora-managed USDC vault on Stellar, built on Upshift. Deposits mint sentUSDC shares representing a proportional interest in the strategy.
Deposit XLM to accrue ecosystem-funded campaign rewards. Rewards depend on the amount and time deposited; early withdrawals forfeit rewards on the amount removed.
Supply USDC to XOXNO’s lending pool to earn borrower interest. Supply shares track accrued value, while the account’s risk group defines its permitted markets.
